main_text.p: præliminaris esse improbandum. Partim propter rationes, contra duella suscepta, judicii gratia, allegatas; partim quia fallax ex eo sumitur præjudicium, quod casuale[?] sortitur[?] eventum. Nonnunquâ enim belli victoria stetit à partibus ejus, qui in priori certamine succubuerat. Et vice versâ, recessit nonnunquâ superatus, qui in duello tentaminis gratiâ adhibito, victoriæ palmam reportaverat. Ut inepti atque iniqui sint arbitratores, qui dubium Martis eventum, super duelli aleâ constitutum esse volunt.
main_text.head: CAP. IX. Quid statuendum de certamine duorum ultimo supplicio justè additorum?
main_text.p: NOn quicquid publicâ fua-dente Auctoritate com-mit-

page.notes: The page number is printed as "8o", read here as 80. The initial N is a large woodcut-style letter, joined to "On" as "NOn". "casuale[?]" is partly blurred; the word may be "casualem". "sortitur[?]" is read with long s as s; the printed form may be "fortitur". Both are doubtful readings. The running head "P. VOET" has spaced capitals. The line "commit-" ends the page mid-word, so the paragraph continues on the next page. A faint library/digitiser watermark at the bottom right was left out.
